hypothesis: A matched-seed three-block control tests whether longer replay retention contributed to H weakness against E; no assumed improvement.
basis: H completed 2048 games but selected H2048 won only 13/64 against E, with 19 timeouts. Prior H comparison lacked a matched-seed control.
change: Replay retention 12 to 3; training seed, model, learning budget and all other settings match H.

development.selection: highest minimum opponent win fraction, then aggregate wins, then fewer total timeouts, then earliest checkpoint
development.gate: strictly >60% wins and <=20% timeouts against EACH opponent

confirmation.only_after: complete training/development and frozen selected hash passing development gate
confirmation.gate: 95% Wilson lower win fraction >0.5 and <=20% timeouts against EACH opponent

replication.status: separate later bounded iteration only if first seed passes; required before promotion

scope: Fixed arena; seeds vary sampling not layouts. No promotion or homepage replacement in this iteration. Confirmation remains unopened unless gate passes.

paired_control.description: Frozen H2048 is evaluated on the SAME fresh development seeds/opponents as I, plus selected I vs H2048 on seed 62030000, 64 balanced games. Diagnostic only, excluded from selection and promotion gate.
